timingCaveat: Concurrent CPU grading; separate CPU LaMa and MLX GPU runtimes. Observational durations, not a controlled benchmark. RSS is lifetime process high-water mark, not isolated per-generation memory.

protocol.purpose: Quality comparison authorized by user; performance recorded, not a rejection gate
protocol.maskSource: Frozen reviewed 512 masks from moebius-quality-yzitv43p; fixed native coverage; identical model hole per matching input resolution
protocol.photographicInput: Original full-resolution embedded camera JPEG, fixed native crop FOV, Lanczos resampling
protocol.rawInput: Separate model generation from fixed AgX/sRGB Rust research plate, u8 quantization equal for every model, +2 EV model exposure on indoor cases reversed at decode

qwen.adapter: none; regular base checkpoint; not Lightning

protocol.qwen1024: Interrupted at early denoising after approximately 23sec/step; no completed output; not counted as quality failure
protocol.rawDevelopBlockReason: No real EOS Kiss M camera calibration profile available to white-balance qualification harness
protocol.controls: Identity encode/decode+fp16 and resize-only on all RAW grades; immutable-original SHA256; outside-coverage assertions
limitations: 8-bit converted Klein/Qwen checkpoints, not full precision qualification
Generated details upsampled using bilinear only
Research inverse of SDR encoding is not a shipping RAW reconstruction guarantee
Concurrent CPU grading and model tests: timing is observational, not controlled benchmark

coverageDetails.photographic: Frozen 512 mask with 2px linear outer feather lifted bilinear to native; protected pixels zeroed
coverageDetails.raw: Exact shared production mask preparation with 8 source pixel hole, 4 source pixel smoothstep coverage; all models use identical native coverage
coverageDetails.comparisonScope: Models and resolutions are matched within each mode. Photographic-vs-RAW differences also include the coverage recipe; do not attribute every difference to color encoding.
